page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and running on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile includes 8 dedicated vCPUs paired with 60.0 GB of system memory, delivering a ratio of 7.5 GB of RAM per core. Network performance is defined by a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Acceleration features comprise two NVIDIA P100 GPUs that provide a combined total of 32 GB VRAM. Additionally, the instance is provisioned with 944 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage, offering low-latency disk access directly on the hypervisor host.

Combining multi-GPU hardware, dedicated host cores, and local SSD storage into a single resource unit eliminates the need for external block storage attachments for temporary scratch data. This configuration provides qualitative resource density for parallel compute tasks. Appropriate workloads include deep learning model training, artificial intelligence inference, parallel scientific computations, and GPU-accelerated data processing.
